note: Known-outstanding unbacked backingSkillIds — services citing a skill that does not exist. SHRINK-ONLY. Do NOT clear an entry by deleting the citation: evaluateCoworkerServiceReadiness already renders it as "Missing skill: X", so deletion flips the service from honestly-not-ready to falsely-ready. Clear it by writing the skill or retiring the service. See BI-5C1978C7.

consequentialGateFloor.note: TAK §8.4.2 — consult-gate coverage is a governed metric. RISE-ONLY: this floor is reach to hold, not debt to burn down. It falls only by a tool losing its declared `consequence` or the composition root losing the resolver install, both of which leave a gate that still passes its own tests.
